_doc: Canonical scenarios (cf. Table II of the reference paper). `expect.top` = acceptable causes; a case passes if one of them is ranked first (top1) or in the top 3 (top3). Safety, unrelated and contraindication expectations are hard requirements. `photo` holds synthetic hydro/vision.py metrics.
